source: GST gross revenue collections (GSTN / PIB) via https://data.gov.in/ (Open Government Data)
note: SEED pack. `value` is the latest headline gross-GST-collection YoY growth (a broad consumption/formalisation proxy); refresh from data.gov.in with scripts/refresh_macro.py --kind gst before relying on the magnitude. `neutral` is the nominal-growth baseline mapping to a zero nudge. `sector_sensitivity` is a maintained crosswalk of consumption exposure (0..1; NSE-Industry + yfinance) and is never touched by a fetch. tailwind = clamp(((value-neutral)/GST_SCALE) * sensitivity, -1, 1). Not investment advice.
